verdict.rationale: Featurebase's site directly claims embeddable changelog widgets that showcase new updates inside your product and website (featurebase-docs-8). It also supports targeting release notes by user attributes (featurebase-docs-6), and the featurebase-js SDK shows an in-app embedding pattern, though that SDK is documented for the messenger, not the changelog. Missing for 10: developer docs or a code example for installing and configuring the changelog widget, widget customization details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
